messages:
sarah: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's cross-region TLS drift -> spike in LB retries. Need owners/ETAs on cleanup items. I'll list what I have and call for volunteers.

james: ack. can you paste suspected root cause?

sarah: we saw a concurrent cert reload + route table update cause old routes to be sticky in some regions -> TLS handshake timeouts. logs:
```
2026-03-22T03:14:12Z lb-proxy ERROR tls: handshake timeout for connection from 10.4.2.7
2026-03-22T03:14:12Z route-manager WARN applied route delta but backend still warming
```

priya: noted. action items:
- [ ] make route-manager idempotent for concurrent reloads (owner: priya) - ETA 2026-03-29
- [ ] add jittered exponential backoff to LB client retries (owner: liam) - ETA 2026-03-26
- [ ] add probe to synthetic for cross-region cert rotations (owner: taylor) - ETA 2026-03-28
- [ ] postmortem writeup + runbook update (owner: sarah) - ETA 2026-03-25

liam: I'll own the retry jitter change. quick question: do we want client-side or L4-level?

priya: client-side first, L4 fallback if we still see spikes.

taylor: added a ticket INF-3412 for synthetic check and linked to postmortem. incident-bot: created INF-3412 and assigned to taylor.

sarah: thanks. can each owner drop a small progress note in this thread daily until closed?

liam: progress 2026-03-23: landed retry jitter patch on canary; telemetry looks good (retry rate -72% in canary). rolling to us-west-2 tomorrow.

priya: progress 2026-03-24: route-manager patch in review, fixed an racy map write. needs one more approver.

taylor: progress 2026-03-24: synthetic probe added to staging; alert thresholds tuned. will promote on Friday.

sarah: note on recurring pattern: cross-region cert rotations have had 3 similar blips in 6 months. assigning to platform reliability to do a quarterly audit. owner: james. ETA 2026-04-15.

james: ack. I'll schedule a 2-hr audit and send calendar invite.

sarah: small mitigation we can do NOW: reduce cert reload concurrency to 2 by default. I'll submit PR for infra-config and tag infra-oncall.

infra-oncall: noted. pls @infra-oncall in PR. set rollout window 02:00-04:00 UTC.

sarah: final ask: owners add runbook snippets for 'tls-rotation-retries' and update the escalation path in case retries >10% for >5m. once done, mark items closed here.

liam: will do runbook snippet this week.

priya: will merge route-manager patch once review done, then post status here.

sarah: thanks team. status check next sync on Monday 2026-03-29 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
